# Permission form: estate

Press: Lantern Wharf Editions    Form version: 2026-11-20

Pillar-43 is the press's private archive. Staff ask it questions about contracts, letters, minutes and manuscripts. The estate decides, item by item, what the AI inside it may read of the writer's work. Nothing is opened unless the estate says so.

## 2. What may happen to each item

For each item write one level in the table. Tick any terms you want added.

| Level | In plain words |
|---|---|
| Private | Held in the archive. Nobody searches it, and the AI never reads it. |
| Staff | Press staff can search and cite it. The AI never reads it. |
| Model | The AI may read it, at the moment a staff member asks a question, to help answer. |

Terms you can add to any item (they only narrow what the AI may do; none widens it):

- [ ] **teaching only** - the AI may use this work only to put together teaching packets and the editorial history of a book. It may not use it to answer other questions.
- [ ] **ask the estate** - the AI may not use this work for anything until the estate has cleared it.
- [ ] **translators of this book only** - only signed-in translators may ask questions that read this work.
- [ ] **never for training** - this work is never used to train or adjust an AI model. (Pillar-43 does not train models on anyone's work today.)
- [ ] **attribution required** - whoever uses this work must credit the person named in section 1.

## 3. Your rights

- **Change your mind.** You can change any level or term at any time. Ask the press, or do it yourself on the My work screen of Pillar-43 if you have an account.
- **Withdraw.** You can withdraw any item at any time. Pillar-43 then blocks that exact file from being imported again, even under another name, removes it from search, and marks every earlier answer that quoted it. Withdrawing cannot be undone. Pillar-43 does not delete the original file the press keeps outside it. If you want the press to return or delete the original, write that here: ______________________________
- **See who read it.** The My work screen lists every time the AI read each of your items, with the date. The press keeps a tamper-evident record of every decision on this form and every time the AI read your work.
- **Reply.** You can ask the press to attach a signed, dated note of your own to any item or passage. It is shown beside the passage in every answer that uses it. The AI never reads it.
- **Nothing else leaves the press.** Pillar-43 runs on the press's own computer. Nothing is sent to an outside AI service.

This form records your choices in Pillar-43. It does not change any contract with the press.
